answers.core: Yes, it's very important to have normal popup menus that don't get in the way. Toolbars in game UI aren't always at the top of the screen. It's kind of an issue in the Godot editor too where tooltips appear right under the mouse.
answers.workaround: It's hacky but the only way I found was to calculate it myself and set the popup menu location in `_process`.

title: Add a Popup Location property to MenuButton
